霍尔木兹再遭油轮袭击，本周已两名海员失踪

Fresh Tanker Strike Adds to Bloody Week in Hormuz

UKMTO reported an unidentified tanker hit in its engine room about six nautical miles north of Khasab on Wednesday evening with all crew safe, following Tuesday's strike on ADNOC's Navig8 Messi (one missing, 11 injured) and Monday's double strike on LPG carrier Tara Gas (one missing, two injured). The US also tightened warnings on ship-to-ship transfers of Iranian cargo, with the Joint Maritime Information Center rating the threat severe. This is a new Wednesday incident, distinct from Tuesday's case covered yesterday.

UKMTO 称周三傍晚一艘身份不明油轮在霍尔木兹海峡驶出时于阿曼哈萨布以北约 6 海里机舱遭袭，船员安全。此前周二 ADNOC 油轮 Navig8 Messi 遭袭致 1 人失踪、11 人受伤，周一 LPG 船 Tara Gas 两度遭袭弃船、1 人失踪、2 人受伤。美方同步收紧对伊朗石油船转船货物的拦截警告，联合海事信息中心维持“严重”威胁评级。本条为周三新发生的袭击，与昨日已刊周二个案不同。

02地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月20日

LPG 船 Tara Gas 在霍尔木兹的火势已扑灭

LPG Tanker Tara Gas Fire Extinguished in the Strait of Hormuz

The fire on the Panama-flagged LPG tanker Tara Gas (IMO 9290270) appears under control two days after it was hit in the engine room on 16 November, with the vessel brought into a sheltered bay west of Shishah and NASA FIRMS thermal signals fading. All crew were rescued with two injured taken to Khasab Hospital, save for one crew member who remains missing. The article also discusses a possible Omani move to restrict territorial-sea transit on environmental grounds under UNCLOS Article 233. Published 2026-11-19T18:04-0500, i.e. 07:04 on 20 November Singapore time.

本条为跟进：巴拿马旗 LPG 船 Tara Gas（IMO 9290270）11 月 16 日机舱遭无人机击中起火，两天后火势受控，船只被拖入 Shishah 以西的避风海湾，NASA FIRMS 热信号已减弱。拖轮 Valiant Vortex 参与灭火；船员获救、两人送 Khasab 医院，仍有一人失踪。原文并讨论阿曼援引《联合国海洋法公约》第 233 条以环保理由限制领海通行的可能。发布时戳为 2026-11-19T18:04-0500，折合新加坡时间 11-20 07:04。

03地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月19日

伊朗在油价下滑之际加剧霍尔木兹油轮袭击

Iran Intensifies Hormuz Tanker Attacks Just as Oil Prices Slide

Iran's attacks on oil tankers crossing the Strait of Hormuz have intensified even as Brent futures slid about a fifth this month and Middle East exports approached pre-war levels, Bloomberg reported. UKMTO has reported roughly one attack a day this month, with about 14 incidents and at least two seafarers missing this week, while Kpler data show the seven-day average of Hormuz oil transits and Gulf of Oman ship-to-ship transfers eased to about 10 million barrels a day by 10 November from around 13.4 million at the start of the month. This is an analytical assessment with new figures, not a repeat of a single incident.

彭博称，伊朗对穿越霍尔木兹海峡油轮的袭击在 10 月升高后于 11 月延续高强度，UKMTO 本月已报告约 14 起事件、接近每日一起，本周至少两名海员失踪。与此同时布伦特本月已跌约五分之一，中东出口接近战前水平，IEA 称供应自战争以来首次超过需求。Kpler 数据显示经霍尔木兹石油过境与阿曼湾船对船转运的七日均值已由月初约 1,340 万桶/日降至 11 月 10 日约 1,000 万桶/日。本条为综合评估，含新数字，非单一个案重复。核实限制：原文页打开时遇限流，摘要基于转载可见正文与署名核对。

04地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月19日

油轮在海湾经船对船转运装载伊朗原油，或成 7 月封锁以来首个成功出口

Oil Tanker Loads Iranian Crude in Gulf, TankerTrackers.com Says

A tanker was loading Iranian crude in the Gulf via ship-to-ship transfer on Thursday and could become the first vessel to successfully export the country's crude since the US reimposed its naval blockade in July, TankerTrackers.com said. The vessel, which was not identified and is not under US Treasury sanctions, would mark the first successful seaborne export since mid-July if it leaves the blockade perimeter. Whether it has done so is unconfirmed; the report says it could become the first, not that it already has.

船舶监测机构 TankerTrackers.com 称，一艘油轮周四在海湾通过船对船转运装载伊朗原油，若能驶出封锁范围，将成为美国 7 月重施海军封锁以来首个成功出口的伊朗海运原油。该船未被点名且不在美国财政部制裁名单上；封锁以来可见的伊朗原油出口已降至近乎为零。本条为昨日已刊封锁规则的具体装载动态跟进；是否成功驶出尚未证实，原文用词为 could become，不可写成已成功出口。

曾挂靠乌克兰港口或成黑海打击目标

Previous Ukraine Port Calls Could Put Ships in Black Sea Firing Line

Ambrey found five of six merchant vessels attacked in Romanian and Bulgarian waters since 13 November had called at Ukrainian ports in 2026, warning targeting may extend to other ships of the same owner or manager. The sunken Betul 8 last called Ukraine on 8 July, while Gas Husky's 19 crew were rescued with two minor injuries, and the Philippines is considering expanding its high-risk area designation. This is new targeting analysis, distinct from yesterday's Kerch Bridge and Gas Husky incident reports.

英国安保机构 Ambrey 称 11 月 13 日以来在罗马尼亚、保加利亚水域遭袭的 6 艘商船中 5 艘在 2026 年曾挂靠乌克兰港口，目标筛选或扩展至同一船东或管理人的其他船舶。沉没的 Betul 8 最后一次确认挂靠乌克兰为 7 月 8 日，Gas Husky 19 名船员获救、2 人轻伤，菲律宾正考虑扩大高风险海区。本条为目标筛选新分析，与昨日已刊刻赤大桥与 Gas Husky 个案不同。

06地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月19日

IBF 将黑海高风险区扩展至罗马尼亚与保加利亚沿岸水域

IBF Extends Black Sea High Risk Area to Waters Off Romania and Bulgaria

The IBF Warlike Operations Area Committee agreed a new list on 18 November, valid to 3 December, extending the Black Sea High Risk Area south along the Romanian and Bulgarian coasts beyond 12 nautical miles, while downgrading the southern Red Sea and Gulf of Aden from Warlike to High Risk (the Yemeni coast within 12 nautical miles remains Warlike), removing the Israel and Lebanon areas, and keeping the Persian Gulf–Hormuz–Gulf of Oman as Warlike. Seafarers in a High Risk Area are entitled to a 100% basic-wage bonus, doubled death and disability compensation and the right to refuse. The list was agreed on 18 November and reported on 19 November; readers should check the ITF public list and their collective agreement.

国际谈判论坛（IBF）战争行动区委员会 11 月 18 日同意新名单（延至 12 月 3 日）：黑海高风险区南延至罗马尼亚、保加利亚沿岸 12 海里以外水域，红海南部与亚丁湾由战争行动区降为高风险区（也门沿岸 12 海里仍为战争区），以色列与黎巴嫩两区取消，波斯湾—霍尔木兹—阿曼湾维持战争行动区。高风险区内 IBF 船员享基本工资 100% 奖金、死亡伤残双倍赔偿与拒航权。名单同意日为 11 月 18 日、报道日为 11 月 19 日；来源为专业风险情报刊物，刊发应以 ITF 公开页与船员集体谈判协议为准。

印度航运部长谴责商船袭击，检视霍尔木兹以西 9 艘印度关联船舶安全

Maritime Security: Sonowal Condemns Attacks, Reviews Safety of Vessels

Shipping Minister Sarbananda Sonowal on Thursday condemned repeated attacks on commercial vessels, particularly those involving Indian seafarers, and reviewed measures to strengthen maritime safety. The ministry is monitoring nine India-flagged or Indian-interest vessels west of the Strait of Hormuz, with 86 transits made by India-flagged vessels or those carrying cargo bound for India, while the E-Navik system tracks more than 800 vessels west of the strait and more than 200 to the east.

印度港口、航运与水道部长 Sarbananda Sonowal 周四谴责针对商船、尤其涉及印度海员的反复袭击，并检视加强海事安全措施。部方正监测霍尔木兹以西波斯湾水域 9 艘印度旗或印度利益船舶，印度旗或载运印度货物的船舶已过境 86 次；E-Navik 系统追踪海峡以西 800 多艘、以东 200 多艘船舶。

美委员会敦促 FMC 调查中国港口国监督扣船

US Panel Urges FMC Probe into China's PSC Vessel Detentions

The US-China Economic and Security Review Commission urged Congress to classify China's detentions of Panama-flagged commercial ships as economic coercion and direct the Federal Maritime Commission to investigate the pattern and report within 90 days. The 2026 Annual Report, released on Wednesday 18 November and reported by Seatrade on 19 November, also proposed assessing Chinese presence across ports in the Western Hemisphere and closer monitoring of agricultural shipping corridors.

美中经济与安全审查委员会（USCC）2026 年度报告建议国会将中国扣留巴拿马旗商船定性为“经济胁迫”，并指示联邦海事委员会（FMC）在 90 天内调查扣船模式并报告。报告还建议评估中国在西半球港口的存在，并加强对农业航运走廊的监测。报告发布日为周三（11 月 18 日），Seatrade 报道日为 11 月 19 日。

载俄柴油油轮绕过美国抵达巴西

Tankers with Russian Diesel Reach Brazil After Bypassing the U.S.

Two tankers laden with Russian diesel arrived in Brazil, while none of the promised Russian product has reached the US, analysts said. The Sierra Leone-flagged Leruo, believed to carry about 40,000 metric tons loaded at Primorsk, and the Russian-flagged Primorye reached the Itacoatiara anchorage, with a third tanker, Beast, reporting Brazil For Orders off South America. The Middle East War Has Wiped 2.8 Billion Barrels Off Global Oil Supply

The Middle East war has caused global oil supply losses totalling 2.8 billion barrels plus 60 billion cubic metres of natural gas, the IEA estimated in its latest World Energy Outlook. In an extreme case, Hormuz flows could fall from 20 million barrels daily before the war to 8.5 million in 2030 and less than 2 million in 2035 as alternative routes develop, while oil and gas demand still grows under the Current Policies Scenario. The 2.8 billion barrels is a cumulative loss estimate, not a daily figure.

The IEA projects the global oil tanker fleet could expand 45% and the LNG carrier fleet 80% by 2050 under its Current Policies Scenario, with oil and gas shipping rising from about 32 trillion to 47 trillion tonne-kilometres. Even under the Stated Policies Scenario tanker capacity needs rise 35% and LNG carriers 60%, while weather-related port downtime could increase 35% by mid-century and Cape of Good Hope diversions can add 13,000 km and 26 days.
